Hi there,


Thank you for building with us, you're the reason we get to take this next step.

Today we announced Runable's $21M Series A, co-led by Susquehanna and Nexus Venture Partners, along with Together Fund and Array
VC who've been with us since the start.


We started Runable because small businesses should be able to build, run, and grow with the same leverage as much larger teams.
This round lets us move faster on that mission and bring Runable to more businesses around the world.
Watch the announcement video [https://x.com/itsumeshk/status/2092632126231609849]


Umesh
